stories.headline: OpenAI considers slowing AI development
stories.summary: Sam Altman told staff OpenAI could slow development alongside other labs, Bloomberg reported. Details are limited, and Reuters did not independently establish a coordinated industry agreement.

stories.headline: California curbs addictive social-media features
stories.summary: California enacted a 13-bill child-safety package restricting addictive social-media features for under-16s and banning AI companion toys for four years. Critics warn of privacy and speech risks.

stories.headline: UAE redesigns major AI data-center project
stories.summary: The UAE is considering dispersing and hardening its planned 5-GW AI campus after Iranian attacks, sources said. G42 says work continues and project details remain under review.

stories.headline: Houthis reach strategic Bab el-Mandeb island
stories.summary: Four Yemeni government sources said Houthi forces reached Perim island and took nearby Dhubab. Full control is not established; the advance could further threaten a vital shipping corridor.

stories.headline: IEA warns global oil-supply gap is widening
stories.summary: The IEA now expects 2026 supply to fall 5.7 million bpd and inventories to keep shrinking as Gulf flows remain disrupted. It projects normal Gulf supply will not return until 2027.
